{{short description|French Academy of Sciences award in mathematics, physics, and biology}}
{{use dmy dates|date=February 2021}}
The '''Prix Paul Doistau–Émile Blutet''' is a biennial prize awarded by the [[French Academy of Sciences]] in the fields of [[mathematics]] and [[physical sciences]] since 1954. Each recipient receives 3000 euros.<ref name = "prix">{{cite web |language=fr |url= http://www.academie-sciences.fr/archivage_site/activite/prix/laureat_doistau_su.pdf |title= Prix Paul Doistau-Emile Blutet (sciences de l’univers), Lauréats 2002-2011 |publisher= [[French Academy of Sciences]]}}</ref><ref name = "prixuniv">{{cite web |language=fr |url= http://www.academie-sciences.fr/archivage_site/activite/prix/laureat_doistau_su.pdf |title= Prix Paul Doistau-Emile Blutet (sciences de l’univers), Lauréats 2002-2011 |publisher= [[French Academy of Sciences]]}}</ref> The prize is also awarded quadrennially in [[biology]].<ref name = "prixbio">{{cite web |language=fr |url=http://www.academie-sciences.fr/archivage_site/activite/prix/laureat_doistau_bioint.pdf |title= Prix Paul Doistau-Émile Blutet (biologie intégrative) : Lauréats 2000-2012 |publisher= French Academy of Sciences |accessdate=1 September 2013}}</ref> The award is also occasionally awarded in other disciplines.<ref name="prix2019-2"/>
